name: zsnd_wave_data_load_and_parse_if_needed
description: zSndWaveData::LoadAndParseIfNeeded loads a named WAV file into memory, parses it, and caches parsedOk.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 /MD byte verification for 0x4a5540 zSndWaveData::LoadAndParseIfNeeded through the zsnd_wave_data_load_and_parse_if_needed target passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after masking 28 COFF relocation bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a5540 validates that already parsed data returns 1; null nameOrPath or failed fopen returns 0; otherwise the function opens nameOrPath with rb, stores zUtil::ZRDR_GetFileSize into fileSize, calloc's fileData, fread's the full file, closes the stream, calls ParseLoadedWaveFile, stores parsedOk, and returns it.
The native load/parse/reset smoke writes a temporary PCM RIFF file, loads it through zSndWaveData/LoadAndParseIfNeeded, and verifies fileSize, fileData, parsedOk, fmt, pcmData, and pcmByteCount.
The native edge smoke verifies null nameOrPath, missing-file failure, and already-parsed early return.
